comments.text: I had one metal lunchbox to last me all 4 years of middle school. Before that, it was a paper bag. That lunchbox was good and rusted by the end of that last year. Clothing? My pants were purchased unhemmed and then hemmed up 4 to 6 inches. Of course, the hem wasn't let down for over a year, and by then, I was displaying a couple inches of my white tube sox. I was made well aware that a savings bond in my name was cashed in to pay for a new pair. We might eat at a restaurant once during the year when we weren't on Summer vacation.
